clients_workspace_email_idx.name: clients_workspace_email_idx
clients_workspace_email_idx.where: "clients"."email" is not null and "clients"."deleted_at" is null

clients_workspace_external_reference_uni.name: clients_workspace_external_reference_unique
clients_workspace_external_reference_uni.where: "clients"."external_reference" is not null and "clients"."deleted_at" is null

consultations_schedule_window_check.name: consultations_schedule_window_check
consultations_schedule_window_check.value: "consultations"."scheduled_end" is null or "consultations"."scheduled_start" is null or "consultations"."scheduled_end" > "consultations"."scheduled_start"

consultations_actual_window_check.name: consultations_actual_window_check
consultations_actual_window_check.value: "consultations"."ended_at" is null or "consultations"."started_at" is null or "consultations"."ended_at" > "consultations"."started_at"

generated_artifacts_target_window_check.name: generated_artifacts_target_window_check
generated_artifacts_target_window_check.value: "generated_artifacts"."target_end" is null or "generated_artifacts"."target_start" is null or "generated_artifacts"."target_end" >= "generated_artifacts"."target_start"

generated_artifacts_token_check.name: generated_artifacts_token_check
generated_artifacts_token_check.value: ("generated_artifacts"."input_tokens" is null or "generated_artifacts"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("generated_artifacts"."output_tokens" is null or "generated_artifacts"."output_tokens" >= 0)

workspaces_slug_unique.name: workspaces_slug_unique
workspaces_slug_unique.where: "workspaces"."slug" is not null and "workspaces"."archived_at" is null
